about.name: Coach Sean Rinehart
about.title: QB/RB/OL/DB
about.bio:
Coach Sean Rinehart brings 4 years of experience running the Split Back v system in Michigan. With a sharp offensive mind and a track record of developing athletes who perform at the next level, Coach Rinehart is known for making practice reps count. Works with athletes at the College, Varsity, Middle School, Youth level.

From route running to pre-snap reads to protection schemes — Coach Rinehart delivers the kind of coaching that shows up in the box score.

services.title: Split Back v System Coaching
services.description: Installation and development of the Split Back v offense — from core concepts to advanced adjustments that put defenses in conflict.

services.title: Skill Position Development
services.description: Individual coaching for QBs, WRs, RBs, and TEs focused on technique, route running, footwork, and pre-snap reads.

services.title: Offensive Playbook & Film Study
services.description: Playbook design tailored to your personnel, plus film sessions that sharpen in-game decision making for players and staff.
